name: milestone-timeline
title: Milestone Timeline
description: A three-step roadmap that turns a process into a clear time-bound story.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite, add dates, or tailor the three milestones; use a custom diagram only when the process no longer fits a simple three-step path.

variables.label: Title
variables.default: A path from intent to impact

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

useWhen: Show exactly three genuine ordered milestones with short labels.
avoidWhen: Do not invent dates, imply causality from chronology or squeeze a long history into three arbitrary points.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.stepOne: A genuine ordered milestone, not an invented date; at most 40 characters.
inputRules.stepTwo: A genuine ordered milestone, not an invented date; at most 40 characters.
inputRules.stepThree: A genuine ordered milestone, not an invented date; at most 40 characters.

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches milestone 1, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches milestone 2, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches milestone 3, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

example.narration: 先完成走访，再准备场地，最后开始试课。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the time span → Advance through three milestones → Read the full timeline. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
usage.intent: 沿真实时间顺序连接三个节点，让观众理解事件怎样走到当前状态。
